description: Customer support email classifier evaluation dataset

test_cases.input: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription.

expected_output.summary: Customer was charged twice for their monthly subscription.

test_cases.notes: Basic duplicate-charge case used to test billing classification.

test_cases.input: I requested a refund five days ago, but the money has not arrived.

expected_output.summary: Customer has not received their requested refund.

test_cases.notes: Tests whether the model recognizes a delayed refund request.

test_cases.input: My invoice shows an incorrect amount for this month.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports an incorrect amount on their invoice.

test_cases.notes: Tests recognition of incorrect invoice amounts.

test_cases.input: I forgot my password and cannot log into my account.

expected_output.summary: Customer cannot access their account because they forgot their password.

test_cases.notes: Basic password-recovery case used to test account classification.

test_cases.input: My account has been locked and I cannot sign in.

expected_output.summary: Customer is unable to sign in because their account is locked.

test_cases.notes: Tests whether the model recognizes account-lockout problems.

test_cases.input: I want to update the email address associated with my profile.

expected_output.summary: Customer wants to change the email address linked to their profile.

test_cases.notes: Tests recognition of profile and account information updates.

test_cases.input: The application crashes every time I try to open it.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports that the application crashes when opened.

test_cases.notes: Basic application-crash case used to test technical classification.

test_cases.input: I receive an error message whenever I try to upload a file.

expected_output.summary: Customer encounters an error when attempting to upload a file.

test_cases.notes: Tests recognition of file-upload failures.

test_cases.input: What are your customer support working hours?

expected_output.summary: Customer wants to know the customer support working hours.

test_cases.notes: Basic general enquiry used to test non-issue-specific requests.

test_cases.input: I would like to suggest adding a dark mode to your application.

expected_output.summary: Customer suggests adding a dark mode to the application.

test_cases.notes: Tests recognition of product feedback and feature suggestions.

test_cases.input: hey i cant loggin to my acount plz help me asap

expected_output.summary: Customer cannot log in to their account and needs assistance.

test_cases.notes: Tests account classification despite spelling mistakes and informal language.

test_cases.input: my app keeps crshing wen i open it

expected_output.summary: Customer reports that the application crashes whenever they open it.

test_cases.notes: Tests recognition of application crashes despite spelling errors.

test_cases.input: u charged me 2 times for dis month

expected_output.summary: Customer reports being charged twice this month.

test_cases.notes: Tests duplicate-payment recognition in informal abbreviated language.

test_cases.input: i need 2 chang my email adress on profile

expected_output.summary: Customer wants to change the email address associated with their profile.

test_cases.notes: Tests profile-update recognition despite spelling and grammatical errors.

test_cases.input: whr can i find ur support timings??

expected_output.summary: Customer wants to know the customer support working hours.

test_cases.notes: Tests general enquiry recognition despite abbreviations and informal wording.

test_cases.input: refund not recived yet its been 1 week

expected_output.summary: Customer has not received their refund after one week.

test_cases.notes: Tests refund-related classification despite spelling and grammar errors.

test_cases.input: My payment was successful, but my premium subscription is still inactive.

expected_output.summary: Customer's payment was successful, but their premium subscription has not been activated.

test_cases.notes: Tests whether the model recognizes a payment-related subscription activation problem.

test_cases.input: I can log in, but my account dashboard shows an error every time.

expected_output.summary: Customer can log in but encounters an error on the account dashboard.

test_cases.notes: Distinguishes a technical dashboard error from an account access problem.

test_cases.input: I received my refund, but the refunded amount is less than what I paid.

expected_output.summary: Customer received a refund but reports that the refunded amount is incorrect.

test_cases.notes: Tests recognition of an incorrect refund amount rather than a missing refund.

test_cases.input: I forgot my password, and the reset link keeps showing an error.

expected_output.summary: Customer cannot reset their password because the reset link produces an error.

test_cases.notes: Tests whether the model identifies account recovery as the primary issue despite a technical error message.

test_cases.input: I want to cancel my subscription because the application keeps crashing.

expected_output.summary: Customer wants to cancel their subscription because the application repeatedly crashes.

test_cases.notes: Tests whether the model identifies the application crashes as the reason behind the cancellation request.

test_cases.input: Can you explain why my account was charged after I cancelled my plan?

expected_output.summary: Customer reports being charged after cancelling their subscription.

test_cases.notes: Distinguishes an unexpected charge from a general account-related enquiry.

test_cases.input: I updated my profile, but the application still displays my old email address.

expected_output.summary: Customer's profile continues to display their old email address after an update.

test_cases.notes: Tests profile information update problems that could be mistaken for general application errors.

test_cases.input: Your application is very slow, and I would like to know if this is a known issue.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports slow application performance and asks whether it is a known issue.

test_cases.notes: Tests whether the model prioritizes the reported performance issue over the general question.

test_cases.input: I subscribed to your premium plan last week. Today I noticed two payments were deducted from my bank account for the same subscription. Please check the duplicate transaction and refund the extra amount.

expected_output.summary: Customer was charged twice for the same premium subscription and requests a refund of the duplicate payment.

test_cases.notes: Tests whether the model identifies duplicate billing as the primary issue in a multi-sentence email.

test_cases.input: I recently changed my phone number and now I cannot access my account. The login page keeps asking me to verify using my old number, which I no longer have. Please help me update my account recovery details.

expected_output.summary: Customer cannot access their account because verification is linked to an old phone number.

test_cases.notes: Tests account recovery classification when several related access problems are described.

test_cases.input: Whenever I open the application, it takes almost a minute to load. Sometimes the screen freezes, and when I try to upload a document, the application closes unexpectedly. This started happening after the latest update.

expected_output.summary: Customer reports slow loading, freezing, and unexpected crashes when uploading documents after a recent application update.

test_cases.notes: Tests whether the model captures multiple technical symptoms in one concise summary.

test_cases.input: I purchased a yearly subscription three weeks ago, but the service did not meet my expectations. I contacted support earlier and was told that my refund would be processed within five business days. It has now been two weeks, and I still haven't received the money. Could you please check the refund status?

expected_output.summary: Customer has not received the promised refund for their yearly subscription and requests a status update.

test_cases.notes: Tests identification of the primary refund issue among several timeline and subscription details.

test_cases.input: I have been trying to update my account details for the past two days. The profile page allows me to enter a new email address, but after clicking save, it returns to the old address. I also tried logging out and logging back in, but nothing changed.

expected_output.summary: Customer cannot update their account email address because the profile continues to revert to the old address.

test_cases.notes: Tests account-profile issue recognition across multiple troubleshooting details.

test_cases.input: I have a question about your application's latest version. Since installing the update yesterday, the application has become extremely slow and frequently displays an unexpected error. Is there a way to fix this without reinstalling the application?

expected_output.summary: Customer experiences slow performance and unexpected errors after the latest application update and asks how to fix them.

test_cases.notes: Tests technical issue recognition and summary generation when a customer also asks for troubleshooting advice.
